items.title: Myth: you still owe FinCEN a BOI report
items.text: Fact: US companies no longer file one (FinCEN, 2026).

items.title: Fact: your state still wants a report
items.text: Many states want one every year or two. Rules vary by state.

items.title: New Jersey: every year
items.text: Due by the end of the month you formed. Skip it and the state can revoke your LLC.

items.text: Biennial statement in the month you formed, or you show as past due.

ig_caption:
Heard your LLC has to file a BOI report with FinCEN? Not anymore. FinCEN's 2026 final rule removed that report for US companies and US owners.

The filing that still catches people is the state one.

✔️ New Jersey: annual report every year, due by the last day of the month your LLC was formed. Miss it and the state can revoke your LLC.
✔️ New York: biennial statement every 2 years, in the month your LLC was formed. Skip it and your LLC shows as past due.
✔️ Other states: rules vary by state.
✔️ Formed in November? Your NJ report is due by November 30.

li_caption:
If you own an LLC, one filing just went away and another one did not.

Myth vs fact:

1. Myth: every LLC must file a beneficial ownership (BOI) report with FinCEN. Fact: FinCEN's final rule, announced August 11, 2026, permanently removed that requirement for US companies and US persons. Foreign companies registered here still report foreign owners.
2. Fact: your state report is still due. New Jersey wants an annual report every year by the last day of the month the LLC was formed. Failure to file can lead to revocation.
3. Fact: New York wants a biennial statement every two years, in the calendar month the LLC was formed. An LLC that skips it shows as past due in state records, which can hold up some transactions.
4. Other states: due dates and fees vary by state. New Jersey notes the duty to file is on the business, even if no notice arrives.

Formed in November? A New Jersey report is due by November 30.

We file LLC annual reports and biennial statements in every state, confirm the details first and track next year's date. Comment REPORT and we will send it.
